summary: 伦敦皇家艺术学院用风景画呈现澳大利亚艺术史，策展人和批评者对这种选择有不同理解。争议涉及殖民联系、原住民艺术的位置和当代澳大利亚的身份。
logic: 原住民艺术与当代身份

paragraphs.brief: 澳大利亚皇家艺术学院选择的"澳大利亚风景展"将成为澳大利亚艺术史的壮观指南。
sentences: For the casual viewer, the exhibition of landscapes, Australia, selected by the Royal Academy of Art, will be a spectacular guide through Australian art history.
澳大利亚皇家艺术学院选择的"澳大利亚风景展"将成为澳大利亚艺术史的壮观指南。

Included in the exhibition are a range of artists and styles, dating from the earliest days of colonial art and progressing through expressionism and modernism to the greats of the 20th century, culminating with the current generation of Australian artists.
展品包括一系列艺术家和风格，从殖民艺术的最初时期，从表达主义和现代主义发展到20世纪的伟大，最后是当代澳大利亚艺术家。
It is hardly surprising, then, that this results in a flexible, wide-ranging notion of landscape.
因此，这并不奇怪，这导致一种灵活、广泛的景观概念。

paragraphs.brief: 但正是地貌景观的主题与来自英国的澳大利亚艺术有着最紧密的联系。
sentences: But this landmark exhibition gives rise to some questions, and perhaps problems, regarding Britain’s relationship with its former colony.
但这次具有里程碑意义的展览引起了一些问题，或许还引起了一些问题，涉及英国与其前殖民地的关系。
By choosing a style of painting at which British artists excel, the Academy could be seen as inviting criticism that hints at a telling attitude towards Australian art by comparison.
通过选择一种英国艺术家优秀的绘画风格，该学院可被视为吸引批评，暗示对澳大利亚艺术的态度比较明确。
But it is the very theme of landscape that provides the strongest connection to Australian art from Britain.
但正是地貌景观的主题与来自英国的澳大利亚艺术有着最紧密的联系。

To consider it condescending is perhaps too strong, but for Joanna Mendelssohn, an Australian critic and Associate Professor at the University of NSW’s College of Fine Arts (COFA), there is a suggestion that British artistic values have directed this exhibition, rather than allowing Australia the freedom to demonstrate its maturity.
称这场展览居高临下也许言重了，但澳大利亚评论家、新南威尔士大学美术学院副教授乔安娜·门德尔松认为，展览似乎受到英国艺术价值观的主导，没有给澳大利亚自主展示其艺术成熟度的空间。

paragraphs.brief: 在审查澳大利亚时，英国人坚持要研究景观绘画的风格。
sentences: What Mendelssohn found surprising about this exhibition was that the underlying rules for the selection of works seemed to have been so conservative.
Mendelssohn对这次展览感到惊讶的是，选择作品的基本规则似乎非常保守。

Since the landscape is a very strong British artistic theme, it appeared to her that when the British looked to the art of a former colony, there was a tendency for them to think that those colonies would continue to be like the British themselves.
因为风景是英国非常强烈的艺术主题，她觉得当英国人看着一个前殖民地的艺术时，有一种倾向是他们认为这些殖民地将继续像英国人自己一样。
In reviewing Australia, the British insisted on looking at the genre of landscape painting.
在审查澳大利亚时，英国人坚持要研究景观绘画的风格。

paragraphs.brief: 由于殖民关系，在澳大利亚艺术的形成年代，它必然会反映英国在自身特性和特异性形成之前对可爱的景观的奉献。
sentences: Because of colonial ties, it was inevitable during Australian art’s formative years that it would reflect Britain’s devotion to the beloved landscape before its own character and idiosyncrasies took shape.
由于殖民关系，在澳大利亚艺术的形成年代，它必然会反映英国在自身特性和特异性形成之前对可爱的景观的奉献。

And while Mendelssohn’s concern over the exhibition’s conventional selection is valid, the Academy is nevertheless embracing the peculiarities of Australian art from the mid-19th century onward, albeit within the boundaries of landscape.
虽然Mendelssohn对展览传统选择的担忧是有道理的，但学院从19世纪中叶开始就接受澳大利亚艺术的独特性，尽管是在地貌的界限之内。

paragraphs.brief: 澳大利亚由皇家学院展览主任Kathleen Soriano主持。
sentences: Australia is curated by Kathleen Soriano, director of exhibitions at the Royal Academy.
澳大利亚由皇家学院展览主任Kathleen Soriano主持。
“Certainly the influence of English, French, or German art is much more evident in the early periods, in the early 1800s to mid-1800s,” she says.
“在18世纪早期至18世纪中叶，英语、法语或德语艺术的影响就更加明显了。”
“What I wanted to show was how Australian art develops a real distinctiveness, associated with the landscape and the light.”
“我想展示的是，澳大利亚艺术是如何发展出与景观和光线相关的真正独特性。”

paragraphs.brief: 将欧洲传统与更具体地说澳大利亚人，往往是个人传统融合在一起，对于展览至关重要，尤其适用于一些更现代的艺术家。
sentences: The fusion of tradition of the European kind with something more specifically Australian, and often personal, is crucial to the exhibition, and extends particularly to some of the more contemporary artists involved.
将欧洲传统与更具体地说澳大利亚人，往往是个人传统融合在一起，对于展览至关重要，尤其适用于一些更现代的艺术家。
Sydney-born video artist Shaun Gladwell is a good example of this.
雪梨出生的视频艺术家Shaun Gladwell就是一个很好的例子。

Gladwell’s most famous piece, which is featured in the exhibition, is Storm Sequence (2000), a video of Gladwell skateboarding on the Bondi seafront as one of Sydney’s signature brutal storms lingers offshore.
格拉德威尔最著名的作品，在展览中出现在Storm Sequence (2000年)，这是格拉德威尔在波迪海滑板的视频，因为悉尼的一个标志性的残酷风暴在海。
It is his acknowledgment of landscape (or seascape) tradition, colored by Gladwell’s own individualism.
这是他对地貌(或海景)传统的认可以格拉德韦尔的个人主义为色彩

“To exhibit my work in this show might make some sense because I was interested in Turner and the idea of atmosphere affecting vision, something I was really interested in around the time of Storm Sequence.
“在这个节目中展示我的工作或许有一定的意义，因为我对特纳感兴趣，对影响视觉的大气层的想法，我对风暴序列时代非常感兴趣。
I was thinking about this tradition of Romantic landscape, but I wanted to make it personal,” says Gladwell.
但我想把它个人"，格拉德韦尔说：“我想到浪漫的风景传统。”
But he didn’t want to just embark on borrowing imagery from elsewhere.
但他不想仅仅从别处借用图像。
He wanted to bring it to his experience and his world through skateboarding and beach culture.
他想通过滑板和海滩文化将它带给自己的经历和世界。

paragraphs.brief: 因此，虽然英国将澳大利亚艺术降格为地貌景观似乎很狭窄，但几乎不能否认英国的景观绘画仍然与当代澳大利亚从业者相关，无论这种相关程度多么间接。
sentences: So while it may seem narrow for Britain to reduce Australian art to the genre of landscape, there can be little denying that British landscape painting is still relevant to a current generation of Australian practitioners, however indirectly.
因此，虽然英国将澳大利亚艺术降格为地貌景观似乎很狭窄，但几乎不能否认英国的景观绘画仍然与当代澳大利亚从业者相关，无论这种相关程度多么间接。

paragraphs.brief: 参观者首先看到澳大利亚原住民艺术。策展人的考虑是，这些作品出现得“最早”，理应占据醒目的位置。
sentences: Visitors to the exhibition encounter Australian Aboriginal art first, the idea being that these works warrant a prominent position because they were ‘first’.
参观者首先看到澳大利亚原住民艺术。策展人的考虑是，这些作品出现得“最早”，理应占据醒目的位置。

Over the last couple of decades, London has hosted many successful exhibitions of Aboriginal art in smaller spaces, but for Soriano, Australia represents an opportunity to place such art in a broader context, with new relationships to the art of the settlers and white Australia.
在过去的几十年里，伦敦在较小的空间主办了许多成功的土著艺术展览，但对于索里亚诺人来说，澳大利亚提供了一个机会，将这种艺术置于更广泛的背景中，与定居者和白人澳大利亚的艺术有新的关系。
‘One of the reasons landscape makes sense as being the right theme was because Aboriginal art started in and on the landscape,’ she says.
她说：“之所以将景观视为正确主题，其中一个原因是土著艺术起源于景观。”
‘[The exhibition] is a beautiful meshing of the two different kinds of art, that allowed me to bring them together comfortably and honestly within this theme.
“[展览]是两种不同艺术的美丽结晶，使我得以在这一主题内使他们舒适而诚实地走到一起。

It was important for me to present Indigenous art to audiences, and I felt it was most authentic that it was seen as part of Australian art history, rather than a separate area with a world of its own.’
“把原住民艺术呈现给观众对我很重要。我觉得，最忠实的呈现方式是将它放在澳大利亚艺术史中，而不是把它划为一个自成一体的独立领域。”

paragraphs.brief: 来自世界各地的澳大利亚学生很想看看威尼斯比恩纳勒和艺术巴塞尔但是他们对去伦敦不感兴趣
sentences: Meanwhile, Australian critic Mendelssohn also points out that London is increasingly less important to today’s generation of artists, and this somewhat weakens the ceremony surrounding the exhibition in London.
同时，澳大利亚的批评家Mendelssohn也指出，伦敦对当今一代艺术家越来越不重要，这在某种程度上削弱了围绕伦敦展览的仪式。
‘China is the most important art market in the world,’ she says.
她说，`中国是世界上最重要的艺术市场'。
‘If you’ve made it in Shanghai, you’ve made it.
如果你在上海成功，你就能成功
The world has changed.
世界已经变了
My students in Australia, who come from all over the world, really want to see Venice Biennale and Art Basel, but they’re less interested in going to London.
来自世界各地的澳大利亚学生很想看看威尼斯比恩纳勒和艺术巴塞尔但是他们对去伦敦不感兴趣
When I was growing up, London was the destination, and then when I was at university all the smart young things wanted to go to New York,’ she added.
她补充说，当我长大时，伦敦是目的地，当我上大学时，所有聪明的年轻人都想去纽约。
‘Now they want to go everywhere.
现在他们想到处走走
There’s no such thing as the centre and the periphery like there used to be.
没有中央和外围这样的东西，像以前那样。
It’s much more complicated.’
更复杂。

items.en: As expected, the artworks chosen for the exhibition reflect a narrow interpretation of landscape.
items.zh: 正如人们所料，这次展览入选的作品体现了对「风景」相当狭窄的理解。
items.why: 作者说所选作品呈现的是灵活而广泛的风景概念；题干把这个概念形容为狭窄。

items.en: The Academy rejected Australian suggestions for the subject of the exhibition.
items.zh: 皇家艺术学院拒绝了澳大利亚方面对展览主题提出的建议。
items.why: 评论家认为展览可能受英国艺术价值观主导。这并不能证明澳大利亚一方曾就主题提出建议，又被皇家艺术学院拒绝。

items.en: The colonial relationship meant that early Australian landscape painting followed the traditions of English landscape painting.
items.zh: 由于殖民关系，早期澳大利亚风景画沿袭了英格兰风景画的传统。
items.why: 文章把形成期澳大利亚绘画对英式风景传统的承袭，直接联系到两地的殖民关系。

items.en: The exhibition reflects the fact that Australian art developed its own particular qualities.
items.zh: 这次展览体现出，澳大利亚艺术已经发展出自己的特色。
items.why: 展览虽然局限于风景题材，仍然展示了澳大利亚艺术自十九世纪中叶起形成的独特之处。

items.en: Contemporary Australian artists have generally rejected British landscape traditions.
items.zh: 当代澳大利亚艺术家总体上排斥英国风景画传统。
items.why: 作者指出英国风景画对当代澳大利亚艺术家依旧具有意义，即使这种影响有时很间接。题干所说普遍拒绝与此相反。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: What is the writer’s main point in the second paragraph?
items.zh: 作者在第二段主要想说明什么？
correct: Britain is still imposing its principles on Australian art.
英国仍在把自己的艺术准则强加给澳大利亚艺术界。

items.en: What does Joanna Mendelssohn find surprising?
items.zh: 什么让乔安娜·门德尔松感到意外？
correct: The guidelines for the choice of work were very traditional.
挑选参展作品所用的标准相当传统。

items.en: Shaun Gladwell’s work is included in the exhibition because
items.zh: 肖恩·格拉德韦尔的作品为什么会入选这次展览？
correct: it adopts a subjective approach to depicting the landscape.
这件作品用主观视角描绘风景。

items.en: What was the reason for Soriano including Aboriginal art in the exhibition
items.zh: 索里亚诺为什么将澳大利亚原住民艺术纳入展览？
correct: It is part of the Australian art tradition and not independent of it.
原住民艺术本来就是澳大利亚艺术传统的组成部分。

items.en: By referring to China, Mendelssohn is making the point that
items.zh: 门德尔松提到中国，是为了说明什么？
correct: having an exhibition in London is not as important as it used to be.
如今在伦敦举办展览，已不像从前那么重要。

items.en: In spite of its conservatism, the Royal Academy exhibition
items.zh: 皇家艺术学院的这次展览虽然保守，却……
items.answer: F · shows an acceptance of the unique qualities of Australian art.
items.solution: 表现出对澳大利亚艺术独特之处的认可。

items.en: Australian art of the early to mid-1800s
items.zh: 19 世纪初至中叶的澳大利亚艺术……
items.answer: E · demonstrates a strong European flavour.

items.en: The modern work by Gladwell chosen for the exhibition
items.zh: 格拉德韦尔入选此次展览的当代作品……
items.answer: A · reflects the mood created by the natural environment.
items.solution: 反映了自然环境营造的氛围。

items.en: Including Aboriginal art in the exhibition
items.zh: 展览纳入原住民艺术，体现了……
items.answer: C · demonstrates an understanding of the historical importance of the land.
items.solution: 对这片土地历史意义的理解。

第 6 段 · 第 1 句
第 8 段 · 第 4 句
points: 评论家认为展览可能受英国艺术价值观主导。这并不能证明澳大利亚一方曾就主题提出建议，又被皇家艺术学院拒绝。
题干问“19 世纪初至中叶的澳大利亚艺术……”。定位句写到““在18世纪早期至18世纪中叶，英语、法语或德语艺术的影响就更加明显了。””。
clauses: But it is the very theme of landscape ….
“that provides the strongest connection to Australian art from Britain”修饰前面的 theme。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 theme，再把修饰信息接回主句。
And …, the Academy is nevertheless embracing the peculiarities of Australian art from the mid-19th century onward, albeit within the boundaries of landscape.
连接词 while 引出“while Mendelssohn’s concern over the exhibition’s conventional selection is valid”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: This exhibition promises to chart the evolution of a nation through its art, but not everyone agrees with the reasons behind the choice of artwork.
这场展览承诺通过艺术来规划一个国家的进化，但并非每个人都同意选择艺术作品背后的原因。
